Title: Public Preview: Encryption in Transit for Azure Files NFS Shares

Body.Content:
Azure Files NFS shares now support in-transit encryption using AZNFS Mount Helper, ensuring end to end encryption of all traffic between clients and servers. The AZNFS mount helper enables seamless, flexible mounting of shares with or without TLS helping organizations stay secure and compliant. Enhance your data security posture with minimal operational changes!  
Learn more.
